[{'type': 'text', 'text': 'Here is a comprehensive `README.md` documentation for your FastAPI Employee Management REST API.\n\n---\n\n# 📋 Employee Management REST API\n\nA lightweight, high-performance RESTful API built with **FastAPI** and **Pydantic** for managing employee records. This project features full CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) capabilities, automatic interactive API documentation, in-memory data storage, and a robust test suite.\n\n---\n\n## 🚀 Features\n\n- **Full CRUD Operations**: Create, read, update, and delete employee records.\n- **Data Validation**: Strict type-checking and validation using Pydantic models.\n- **Partial Updates**: Supports updating specific fields without overwriting the entire record.\n- **In-Memory Database**: Fast, zero-configuration setup using a Python dictionary.\n- **Auto-Generated Docs**: Interactive Swagger UI and ReDoc documentation out of the box.\n- **Automated Testing**: Complete integration test suite using `pytest` and FastAPI\'s `TestClient`.\n\n---\n\n## 🛠️ Tech Stack\n\n* **Language:** Python 3.8+\n* **Framework:** [FastAPI](https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/)\n* **Data Validation:** [Pydantic](https://docs.pydantic.dev/)\n* **ASGI Server:** [Uvicorn](https://www.uvicorn.org/)\n* **Testing:** [Pytest](https://docs.pytest.org/) & [HTTPX](https://www.python-httpx.org/) (required for FastAPI\'s `TestClient`)\n\n---\n\n## 📁 Project Structure\n\n```text\n.\n├── app.py          # Main application code containing API routes and models\n├── test_app.py     # Integration tests for CRUD operations\n└── README.md       # Project documentation\n```\n\n---\n\n## ⚙️ Installation & Setup\n\n### 1. Clone the Repository\n```bash\ngit clone <your-repository-url>\ncd <repository-folder>\n```\n\n### 2. Create and Activate a Virtual Environment\n```bash\n# macOS/Linux\npython3 -m venv venv\nsource venv/bin/activate\n\n# Windows\npython -m venv venv\nvenv\\Scripts\\activate\n```\n\n### 3. Install Dependencies\nInstall FastAPI, Uvicorn, and the testing utilities:\n```bash\npip install fastapi uvicorn pytest httpx\n```\n\n---\n\n## 🖥️ Running the Application\n\nStart the local development server using Uvicorn:\n\n```bash\nuvicorn app:app --reload\n```\n\nThe server will start at **`http://127.0.0.1:8000`**.\n\n### 📖 Interactive API Documentation\n\nOnce the server is running, you can explore and test the API directly from your browser:\n\n* **Swagger UI (Interactive):** [http://127.0.0.1:8000/docs](http://127.0.0.1:8000/docs)\n* **ReDoc (Alternative):** [http://127.0.0.1:8000/redoc](http://127.0.0.1:8000/redoc)\n\n---\n\n## 🔌 API Endpoints Reference\n\n### 1. Create Employee\n* **Endpoint:** `POST /employees/`\n* **Status Code:** `201 Created`\n* **Request Body:**\n  ```json\n  {\n    "id": 101,\n    "name": "Sarah Khan",\n    "role": "Senior Dev",\n    "department": "Engineering"\n  }\n  ```\n* **Response (Success):**\n  ```json\n  {\n    "id": 101,\n    "name": "Sarah Khan",\n    "role": "Senior Dev",\n    "department": "Engineering"\n  }\n  ```\n* **Error (400 Bad Request):** If the Employee ID already exists.\n\n---\n\n### 2. List All Employees\n* **Endpoint:** `GET /employees/`\n* **Status Code:** `200 OK`\n* **Response:**\n  ```json\n  [\n    {\n      "id": 101,\n      "name": "Sarah Khan",\n      "role": "Senior Dev",\n      "department": "Engineering"\n    }\n  ]\n  ```\n\n---\n\n### 3. Get Employee by ID\n* **Endpoint:** `GET /employees/{emp_id}`\n* **Status Code:** `200 OK`\n* **Response:**\n  ```json\n  {\n    "id": 101,\n    "name": "Sarah Khan",\n    "role": "Senior Dev",\n    "department": "Engineering"\n  }\n  ```\n* **Error (404 Not Found):** If the employee ID does not exist.\n\n---\n\n### 4. Update Employee (Partial Update)\n* **Endpoint:** `PUT /employees/{emp_id}`\n* **Status Code:** `200 OK`\n* **Request Body:** (All fields are optional)\n  ```json\n  {\n    "role": "Lead Architect"\n  }\n  ```\n* **Response:**\n  ```json\n  {\n    "id": 101,\n    "name": "Sarah Khan",\n    "role": "Lead Architect",\n    "department": "Engineering"\n  }\n  ```\n* **Error (404 Not Found):** If the employee ID does not exist.\n\n---\n\n### 5. Delete Employee\n* **Endpoint:** `DELETE /employees/{emp_id}`\n* **Status Code:** `200 OK`\n* **Response:**\n  ```json\n  {\n    "message": "Employee deleted successfully",\n    "employee": {\n      "id": 101,\n      "name": "Sarah Khan",\n      "role": "Lead Architect",\n      "department": "Engineering"\n    }\n  }\n  ```\n* **Error (404 Not Found):** If the employee ID does not exist.\n\n---\n\n## 🧪 Running Tests\n\nThe project includes a comprehensive integration test suite in `test_app.py` that verifies the entire CRUD lifecycle.\n\nTo run the tests, execute:\n\n```bash\npytest test_app.py -v\n```\n\n### Test Coverage Details:\nThe `test_full_employee_crud` test case performs the following assertions sequentially:\n1. **Create:** Adds a new employee (`id: 101`) and asserts a `201` status code.\n2. **Read (Single):** Fetches the created employee and asserts a `200` status code.\n3. **Update:** Modifies the employee\'s role to "Lead Architect" and asserts the change.\n4. **Read (List):** Lists all employees and asserts a `200` status code.\n5. **Delete:** Removes the employee and asserts a `200` status code.\n\n---\n\n## 🔒 License\n\nThis project is open-source and available under the [MIT License](LICENSE).', 'extras': {'signature': ''}}]
